authority: Live-measured animation-pass values (encoded in src/styles/upper.css, lower.css, component code) and the independent animation-QA corrections outrank CLONE_SPEC.md §14 where they differ.

noScrollReveal.statement: There are NO scroll-reveal / whileInView animations anywhere. No motion pattern below fades/slides sections in on scroll; a generator must not invent one (the schema's closed motion enums make it impossible).

reducedMotion.statement: The clone has no prefers-reduced-motion handling at all (grep of src/ and index.html: zero matches). Every reducedMotionFallback in this repo is PRESCRIPTIVE guidance for generated pages, not a measured behaviour.

static.reducedMotionFallback: none-required: no section-level motion (primitive hover/press colour changes only).

header-load-and-sticky.reducedMotionFallback: Render header and nav fully visible on load (no fade/stagger); keep the fixed-after-scroll switch but without transition; open the mobile menu without the slide.

parallax-clouds.reducedMotionFallback: Freeze cloud layers at parallax progress 0 (no translate/scale) and pause the horizontal cloud drift.

marquee-press-20s.reducedMotionFallback: Stop the marquee; show the first logo row static with the edge mask kept.

marquee-family-50s-reverse.reducedMotionFallback: Stop the marquee; show the first family row static.

click-opens-modal.reducedMotionFallback: none-required: cards have no hover motion on the original; the modal opens with no entry animation.

embla-loop-with-rive.reducedMotionFallback: Snap between slides with no embla easing; do not autoplay Rive (show the first frame).

embla-loop.reducedMotionFallback: Snap between slides with no embla easing.

faq-clouds-float-and-open.reducedMotionFallback: Clouds static at clear-skies positions; open/close items without size/position transition; apply blur state instantly.

image-hover-scale.reducedMotionFallback: No image scale on hover; pills keep instant opacity change.

search-dropdown-fade.reducedMotionFallback: Show the results dropdown instantly (no 0.2s fade).

sticky-aside.reducedMotionFallback: none-required: sticky positioning only (no animated transition; the progress fill stays at height 0 as on the original).
